title: Patience
note:
Welcome back to Lunch Time with Jesus. Today's reflection is based on 2 Peter 1:3-6, where we are reminded that through His divine power, God has given us everything we need for life and godliness. He has also given us great and precious promises, and our response should be to diligently grow in our faith by adding virtue, knowledge, self-control, patience, and godliness.

Today's focus is on patience. Patience is more than simply waiting in line—it is cheerful endurance. It is the calm ability to wait, endure difficult situations, and face delays without becoming angry or discouraged. Patience allows us to remain peaceful when prayers seem unanswered, when life becomes difficult, when people disappoint us, or when circumstances suddenly change.

However, patience does not mean being idle or doing nothing. It means remaining faithful while we wait, trusting God's timing and continuing to obey Him. In our own strength, this is impossible, but God has given us the Holy Spirit to work within us, enabling us to do His will and walk according to His purpose.

Prayer: Lord, help me to develop true patience through the power of Your Holy Spirit. Teach me to trust Your timing, remain faithful in every season, and endure every challenge with joy and confidence in Your promises. Amen.
